title: Automatic safe GitHub flow (0A.8 item 8; AD-077; Section 19.4 proofs)
objective: Implement and prove the supervisor's automatic ordinary GitHub flow in shadow/dry-run harness: task-branch push allowed, main/force push hard-denied, PR creation, ordinary green-PR merge path, secret-finding block, stale-remote-SHA reconciliation, specialist-review routing for workflow/dependency classes without owner approval, safe merged-branch cleanup, and crash-during-push/merge reconciliation without blind retry - the Section 19.4 test list, each as an executable proof.
business_reason: 0A.8 item 8 (automatic ordinary commit/push/PR/CI/merge/ledger continuation) is a blocking minimum-autonomy capability; AD-006/AD-007/AD-077 are explicit directive requirements.
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): ordinary task-branch push allowed; direct main push and force push hard-denied (tests; Section 19.4).

AS-2 (executable): PR creation and the ordinary green-PR merge path proven in the dry-run harness; merge refuses on failing required check, secret finding, unresolved blocking finding, or stale remote SHA (one test each; Section 5.5).
AS-3 (executable): workflow/dependency change classes route to specialist review without owner approval (Tier B policy test).
AS-4 (executable): branch cleanup deletes only proven-merged task branches; unusual/evidence branches retained (test; Section 5.4).
AS-5 (executable): simulated crash mid-push/mid-merge reconciles from the external-effect journal without blind retry (test; Section 19.4).
risks: All proofs run in dry-run/shadow harness - no live merge occurs before activation (R104).
